name: GetScreenResolutionNode
label: Get Screen Resolution
description: Gets the width, height, bit depth, and refresh rate of one or all monitors.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: Selection
fields.label: Monitor Selection
fields.description: Specify whether to get info for primary, all, or a specific monitor

selectOptions.label: Primary Monitor
selectOptions.description: Get resolution of the primary monitor.

selectOptions.label: All Monitors
selectOptions.description: Get resolution of all connected monitors.

selectOptions.label: Specific Monitor Index
selectOptions.description: Get resolution of a specific monitor by index.

fields.name: MonitorIndex
fields.label: Monitor Index
fields.description: Zero-based index of monitor to check (only used when Selection = SpecificIndex)
